create_issue

Create a new issue in a GitHub repository. Use the search_issues tool first to avoid opening a duplicate, then call this tool with the repository owner, name, title and body.

Returns the issue number and its URL.

Parameters: owner, repo, title, body, labels

The repository owner (user or organization).

Markdown body of the issue. Images such as ![screenshot](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1234.png) are allowed.
